newsitem.title: SPAIN: Aldeasa sees '97 pretax profits up some 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Aldeasa sees '97 pretax profits up some 22 pct.

text.p: Spain's duty-free store operator Aldeasa said on Thursday that it sees 1997 pre-tax rising some 22 percent to about 10 billion pesetas.

"Given this positive evolution, we are confident that the pre-tax results at the end of 1997 will be at some 10 billion pesetas, which would mean growth of some 22 percent compared to 1996," Aldeasa said in a statement.
Sales, it said would reach some 60 billion pesetas. Earlier this month, Spanish tobacco firm Tabacalera said it would buy a 20 percent stake in state-owned Aldeasa September.
